text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I are in the middle<n>of a training
session, timing her runs<n>to check her performance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not making any personal bests<n>today. In fact,
my times are getting<n>worse...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Urgh! If this continues—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I need to check something. I'll<n>be right back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What?! You're leaving already,<n>Taishin?! C'mon,
we should cheer<n>her on a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No thanks. I've seen enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hello, you two.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
OH! Hayahide! Fancy meeting you<n>here! Taishin
and I were just—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Watching me run, right? I know.<n>That's why I came
over here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't leave yet. At least<n>watch me run one
more lap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why do you want us to stick around?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Because you just watched my last<n>run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'm not performing at<n>my best today...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't want you to think this is the<n>best I can do!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to embarrass myself<n>with such a
pitiful performance again.<n>I'm going to show you
your rival's<n>true potential!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine. You get one lap.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's enough for me! Ticket, would<n>you also be all
right staying for one—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Of course I'll stay!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why are you crying?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm just sooo honored that youconsider me to be a rivaaal!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you time me once<n>more?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I need to keep improving. I can't<n>break my promise
to them!
Biwa Hayahide runs her best time of<n>the month.

From that day onward, her running<n>improves
significantly.
